description: This file defines a ResultSet class for 'Project' in a database schema, including methods for finding projects by URL name, filtering non-archived projects, public projects, and projects that are considered stale based on date comparisons.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Project
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling collections of 'Project' records, providing methods for filtering and querying projects based on various criteria.

methods.name: sorted_by_columns
methods.description: Returns the columns used for sorting projects, specifically 'url_name_fc' and 'name'.

methods.name: find_by_url_name
methods.description: Finds a project record by its URL-friendly name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: not_archived
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are not archived.

methods.name: public
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are marked as public.

methods.name: stale
methods.description: Returns a result set of projects that are entirely in the past based on associated 'meals' and 'purchase_lists' dates, indicating they can be archived.
